DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets.summary: Delete Objects or Empty a Bucket
DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets.description:
Deletes objects from an R2 bucket. Three modes are supported:

1. **Delete by list** (default): Provide a JSON array of object keys in the request body.
   All listed objects are deleted; per-key errors are reported in the response.
2. **Delete by prefix**: Provide a non-empty `prefix` query parameter and no request body
   to delete every object whose key begins with that prefix.
3. **Empty bucket**: Provide the `prefix` query parameter with an empty value (`?prefix=`)
   and no request body to delete all objects in the bucket.

Prefix and empty-bucket requests return a job descriptor. Small jobs can finish
synchronously and return `COMPLETED`; larger jobs continue in the background. Poll the
returned `id` with the Get Bucket Job endpoint. Objects uploaded after a background job
starts are not deleted by that job. Abort active multipart uploads before submitting the
request; a synchronously completed job does not abort them. Avoid writing objects or
starting multipart uploads while a bucket-emptying job is in progress.

Each repeated or concurrent request creates a distinct job. The number of active jobs is
limited per bucket; wait for an existing job to finish before retrying a request rejected
with HTTP 429.

A bucket cannot be emptied while event notifications are configured. Remove the event
notification rules and retry requests rejected with HTTP 409 / error code 10034. To
protect a bucket with R2 Data Catalog enabled, send the `cf-r2-data-catalog-check` header;
a conflict is returned with HTTP 409 / error code 10081.

For most workloads, we recommend using R2's [S3-compatible API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/) or a [Worker with an R2 binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/) instead.

schema.description: Account ID.
Name of the bucket.
Jurisdiction where objects in this bucket are guaranteed to be stored.

When present, switches the operation to prefix-delete mode. A non-empty value must
end in `/` and deletes keys beginning with that prefix. Preserve an empty value
(`?prefix=`) to empty the entire bucket. Omitting this parameter instead selects
delete-by-list mode and requires a JSON request body.

parameters.name: cf-r2-data-catalog-check
parameters.description: Set this header to reject the operation when R2 Data Catalog is enabled for the bucket.

requestBody.description:
Required for "delete by list" mode (when `prefix` query parameter is omitted).
A JSON array of object keys to delete. Ignored when `prefix` is provided.

empty-bucket-completed.summary: A small or already empty bucket completed immediately

oneOf.description: Per-key delete results returned in "delete by list" mode.

items.description: Result of a successful object deletion.

key.description: The key (name) of the deleted object.

oneOf.description:
Descriptor of a bucket background job. Returned when the delete-objects endpoint is
invoked with a `prefix` query parameter, and by the Get Bucket Job and List Bucket Jobs
endpoints. An empty prefix indicates an Empty Bucket job. A small operation can already
be `COMPLETED` when it is returned.

endTime.description: When the job finished. Absent while the job is still `ENQUEUED` or `RUNNING`.

id.description: Unique identifier used to poll the job.

jobType.description: The job kind. Always `prefixDelete` for this endpoint.

prefixDelete.description: Details specific to the prefix-delete job.

deletedObjects.description: Number of objects deleted by the job so far.

isBucketClear.description:
True when the job was created to clear the entire bucket. This field can be absent
on jobs created before Empty Bucket job tracking was introduced.

prefix.description: The prefix matched against object keys. An empty string means the entire bucket.

status.description: Lifecycle status of a bucket background job.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

409.description:
Empty Bucket conflict. Event notification rules are still configured (error code
10034), or the Data Catalog check was requested and R2 Data Catalog is enabled for
the bucket (error code 10081). Remove the conflicting configuration before retrying.

event-notifications-active.summary: Event notification rules must be removed first

errors.message: Remove all event notification rules from bucket (example-bucket) before emptying it (account 023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353).

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

429.description: Too many active prefix-delete or bucket-emptying jobs. Wait for an existing job to finish, then retry.

too-many-jobs.summary: The per-bucket active job limit was reached

errors.message: Too many concurrent prefix delete jobs for this bucket. Please wait for existing jobs to complete.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

4XX.description: Delete Objects response failure. The bucket may not exist, the request may be invalid, or the caller may not be authorized.

DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets.description:
Deletes an object from an R2 bucket.

For most workloads, we recommend using R2's [S3-compatible API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/) or a [Worker with an R2 binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/) instead.

schema.description: Account ID.
Name of the bucket.

The key (name) of the object to delete. May contain slashes for path-like keys.
Slashes (`/`) within the key MUST be sent literally and MUST NOT be percent-encoded
(i.e. `%2F`); other reserved characters should be percent-encoded as usual.
Jurisdiction where objects in this bucket are guaranteed to be stored.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

result.description: Result of a successful object deletion.

key.description: The key (name) of the deleted object.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets/{b.description:
Lists objects in an R2 bucket. Returns object metadata including key, size, etag, last modified date, HTTP metadata, and custom metadata.

For most workloads, we recommend using R2's [S3-compatible API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/) or a [Worker with an R2 binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/) instead.

schema.description: Account ID.
Name of the bucket.
Jurisdiction where objects in this bucket are guaranteed to be stored.
Maximum number of objects to return per page.
Restricts results to only those objects whose keys begin with the specified prefix.
A single character used to group keys. All keys that contain the delimiter between the prefix and the first occurrence of the delimiter after the prefix are grouped under a single result element.
Pagination cursor received from a previous List Objects call. Used to retrieve the next page of results.
Returns objects with keys that come after the specified key in lexicographic order.

custom_metadata.description: Custom metadata key-value pairs associated with the object.

etag.description:
The entity tag for the object. In JSON list/get responses this is the raw
hex digest (without surrounding quotes). The HTTP `ETag` response header on
Get Object follows RFC 7232 and IS wrapped in surrounding double-quotes.

http_metadata.description: HTTP metadata associated with an R2 object.

cacheControl.description: Specifies caching behavior for the object.

cacheExpiry.description: The date and time at which the object's cache entry expires.

contentDisposition.description: Specifies presentational information for the object.

contentEncoding.description: Specifies the content encoding applied to the object.

contentLanguage.description: The language of the object content.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the object.

last_modified.description: The date and time the object was last modified.

size.description: The size of the object in bytes.

ssec.description: Whether the object is encrypted with a customer-supplied encryption key.

storage_class.description: Storage class for newly uploaded objects, unless specified otherwise.

result_info.description: Pagination information for list objects responses.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to use in the next List Objects call to retrieve the next page of results.

delimited.description:
Common prefixes found when a delimiter is specified. Each entry represents a group
of keys sharing a common prefix up to the delimiter. Equivalent to S3's `CommonPrefixes`
in `ListObjectsV2`; the field name differs because of the existing R2 API wire format.

is_truncated.description: Whether the result was truncated. If true, use the cursor to retrieve the next page.

per_page.description: The maximum number of objects returned per page.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.
Whether the API call was successful.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets/{b.description:
Retrieves an object from an R2 bucket. Returns the object body along with metadata headers.

For most workloads, we recommend using R2's [S3-compatible API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/) or a [Worker with an R2 binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/) instead.

schema.description: Account ID.
Name of the bucket.

The key (name) of the object to retrieve. May contain slashes for path-like keys.
Slashes (`/`) within the key MUST be sent literally and MUST NOT be percent-encoded
(i.e. `%2F`); other reserved characters should be percent-encoded as usual.
Jurisdiction where objects in this bucket are guaranteed to be stored.
Returns the object only if its ETag does not match the given value.

Returns the object only if it has been modified since the specified time.
Must be formatted as an HTTP-date (RFC 7231), e.g. `Tue, 15 Jan 2024 10:30:00 GMT`.

200.description: Get Object response. Returns the object body with metadata headers.

Content-Length.description: The size of the object in bytes.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the object.

ETag.description:
The entity tag for the object, wrapped in double-quotes per RFC 7232,
e.g. `"d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e"`.

Last-Modified.description:
The date and time the object was last modified, formatted as an HTTP-date (RFC 7231),
e.g. `Tue, 15 Jan 2024 10:30:00 GMT`.

cf-r2-storage-class.description: The storage class of the object.

schema.description: Storage class for newly uploaded objects, unless specified otherwise.
The object body.

304.description: Not Modified. Returned when conditional request headers indicate the object has not changed.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets/{b.description:
Uploads an object to an R2 bucket. The object body is provided as the request body. Returns metadata about the uploaded object.

The maximum upload size for this endpoint is 300 MB. For most workloads, we recommend using R2's [S3-compatible API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/) or a [Worker with an R2 binding](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/) instead.

schema.description: Account ID.
Name of the bucket.

The key (name) to assign to the object. May contain slashes for path-like keys.
Slashes (`/`) within the key MUST be sent literally and MUST NOT be percent-encoded
(i.e. `%2F`); other reserved characters should be percent-encoded as usual.
Jurisdiction where objects in this bucket are guaranteed to be stored.
The MIME type of the object being uploaded.
The size of the object body in bytes.

parameters.name: cf-r2-storage-class
parameters.description: Storage class for this object. Overrides the bucket default.

schema.description: Storage class for newly uploaded objects, unless specified otherwise.
The object body to upload.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.

result.description: Result of a successful object upload.

etag.description: The entity tag for the uploaded object.

key.description: The key (name) of the uploaded object.

size.description: The size of the uploaded object in bytes (as a string).

storage_class.description: Storage class for newly uploaded objects, unless specified otherwise.

uploaded.description: The date and time the object was uploaded.

version.description: The version UUID of the uploaded object.

success.description: Whether the API call was successful.
